name: AI Resume & Portfolio Chatbot
description: An AI-powered chatbot that answers recruiter questions about my resume, projects, and skills.
problem: Recruiters often spend very little time reviewing resumes and portfolios.
solution: Built an interactive chatbot that provides concise, tailored answers using an LLM and structured resume data.
challenges: Designing prompts that sound professional but not exaggerated
lessons: Prompt engineering affects output quality significantly

name: Qt Desktop Application
description: A desktop application built with Qt and C++ featuring multiple interactive UI components.
problem: Learning how to manage UI logic and application state in a large C++ project.
solution: Designed modular UI components and debugged event-handling issues.
challenges: Debugging crashes caused by signal-slot misuse
